prerequisites: Knowledge of the lectures: Fluid Mechanics and Mechanics, as well as Control Engineering

learning_outcomes.text: Students have a good overview of the fundamentals of hydrostatic drives. This applies in particular to the field of mobile hydraulic drives and controls and their application. Students can computationally design drives, select the necessary components, and design the hydraulic circuit diagram. The advantages and disadvantages of individual components and systems are known. Basic knowledge of the complex dynamic behavior of hydraulic drives is known and can be taken into account in the design.
Students have knowledge of mobile hydraulics. This knowledge is practically deepened through the accompanying internship.
Students apply a range of standard and specialized methods to describe and evaluate mobile hydraulic systems.
Students calculate, design, and operate mobile hydraulic systems.
Students are able to conceptualize and design mobile hydraulic powertrains.
formulate technical and factual problem solutions within their actions and justify them in discourse with specialists and non-specialists with theoretically and methodologically sound argumentation.
reflect on and consider different perspectives and interests of other participants.
develop a professional self-image that is oriented towards the goals and standards of professional action in professional fields predominantly outside of science.
justify their own professional actions with theoretical and methodological knowledge.
can assess their own abilities, autonomously reflect on subject-related design and decision-making freedoms, and use them under guidance.

syllabus_topics: Pump circuits (energy supply systems): constant flow, constant pressure and load sensing
Application examples (forestry, agricultural and construction machinery)
Dynamics of hydraulic drives and controls
assessment_rules: The form of examination (written or oral) is chosen by the lecturer. The graded examination performance (written exam or oral exam) duration is according to the respective valid study regulations or general examination regulations. The ungraded examination performance is an experimental work of approximately 1-3 experiments.
